events.title: Faction Checkpoint Established
events.description: An armed garrison has fortified the old depot, placing sandbag berms across the arterial highway. Travel through this node is blocked unless an alternate detour is planned.
events.recast_text: The depot has been fortified with sandbags and barbed wire. Armed sentries watch the highway from the roof.

events.title: Bridge Debris Collapse
events.description: Heavy frost heave and ash load brought down the central span of the highway overpass. Direct travel between eastern outposts is severed, forcing southern bypasses.
events.recast_text: Shattered pre-stressed concrete slabs block the underpass. Vehicles cannot pass.

events.title: Contested Road Barricade in the Cut
events.description: Snipers and anti-vehicle ditching have closed the main gorge pass. Expedition routing must detour around the perimeter ridge.
events.recast_text: Burned-out truck chassis and barbed wire entanglements choke the ravine road.

events.title: Warlords Claim Neutral Ground
events.description: Sector 4 warlord raiders have broken the treaty and occupied the central interchange plaza, imposing tribute tolls on all passing caravans.
events.recast_text: Warlord banners hang from the ruined interchange flyover. Armed patrols demand fuel and water from all travelers.

events.title: Flotilla Coastal Garrison Retreat
events.description: Rising tide and toxic silt have forced the marine garrison to abandon their shoreline watchstation, leaving the armory stores vulnerable to scavengers.
events.recast_text: The coastal watchtower stands empty, doors creaking in the salt wind. Scavengers have begun tearing into the lower bunkers.

events.title: Utility Warehouse Stripped Bare
events.description: A nomadic scavenging pack stripped the surface access building of copper wiring and exposed pipe before moving on.
events.recast_text: The outer tool lockers have been crowbarred open and ransacked. Only buried conduits deeper in the rock remain intact.

events.title: Outskirts Settlement Abandoned
events.description: After water cisterns turned brackish, the last resident family boarded up the windows and fled south. The structure sits dark and decaying.
events.recast_text: The garden fence has collapsed under drift ash. The well rope is cut and the pantry door hangs open to the wind.

events.title: Water Station Reservoir Collapse
events.description: Rust-eaten support struts buckled under a heavy ash gale, toppling the concrete tank into the pump house.
events.recast_text: The concrete reservoir tower came down in the storm. Grey water pools in the crater, and the pumps are crushed under rubble.

events.title: Fallout Dust Plume Intensifies
events.description: Prevailing thermal currents kicked up active fission particles from the crater floor, doubling ambient gamma dose rates across the zone.
events.recast_text: Yellow ash dust swirls waist-high across the crater rim. Dosimeter needles peg hard into the red within seconds of approach.

events.title: Spore Mold Bloom in Underground Concourse
events.description: Warm condensation on subway ceilings has triggered an aggressive fungal eruption. Thick hyphae carpets platforms and stairs, releasing toxic airborne spores.
events.recast_text: Thick bioluminescent mold mats cover the platform edge. The air tastes bitter, smelling of wet rot, and burns unprotected lungs.

events.title: Harbor Overrun — Storm Surge
events.description: A fallout squall drove the sea over the shelf and into the dock works. Crane rails stand knee-deep, the service channel runs backwards, and the Flotilla has suspended all claim work until the water drops. Salvage dives wait; the drowned keep their schedule.
events.recast_text: The water has dropped. The dock works stink of black rain, and the salvage marks have moved.

events.title: Stranded Crew on the Breakwater
events.description: The surge cut the breakwater road off behind the water and left a salvage crew counting their line. A rescue or a supply run is now the difference between a story and a burial.
events.recast_text: The breakwater crew made it back on half rations and one borrowed line. They do not joke about weather anymore.

events.title: The Surge Shifted the Wrecks
events.description: The surge rolled the roadstead. A picket hull that was buried for years now shows its keel at low water, and the safe route past the breakwater silted shut. The Flotilla broadcast new marks the same night.
events.recast_text: New wreckage stands clear of the water on the roadstead side.
